newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS-Int'l Speedway races higher.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS-Int'l Speedway races higher.

text.p: International Speedway Corp shares jumped in heavy trading in their market debut on Tuesday, with the stock rising 1-3/8 to 21-3/8.
The Daytona Beach, Florida-based motor sports promoter is best known for its superspeedways and the Daytona 500 race.

SeaChange International Inc shares rose 2-5/8 to 17-5/8 on its first day. The Maynard, Massachusetts, company makes digital servers that allow cable operators to insert advertisements into television network streams.
Among other companies that made their market debut:
-- Symons International Group Inc shares rose 1-1/16 to 13-9/16. The company is a property and casualty insurer.
-- Candlewood Hotel Co Inc shares gained 1/2 to 10-1/2. The Wichita, Kansas, company develops Candlewood extended-stay hotels.
